neighbours.label: past-perfect ' had': an action already completed before another point in time
fire: By the time the rescue boat arrived, the ferry had sunk beneath the waves.
When I reached the station, the last train had left without me.
Long before sunrise the farmers had gathered the whole harvest.
She realized that she had forgotten her passport at the hotel.
By then the two brothers had sold the shop and moved to Denver.
The guests saw that someone had already eaten most of the cake.
After the storm had passed, the neighbors came out to look.
He told the judge that he had never seen the money before.
quiet: The rescue boat arrived at dawn and the ferry sank beneath the waves.
When I reach the station, the last train leaves without me.
Just before sunrise the farmers gather the whole harvest.
She realizes that she forgets her passport at the hotel every time.
Today the two brothers sell the shop and move to Denver.
The guests saw that someone ate most of the cake.
When the storm passes, the neighbors come out to look.
He tells the judge that he never saw the money before.

notes: The card's commonest peak is an indentation token, but short code passages scored only 0.04 on indents, so indentation could not be reproduced here. ' had' reached 0.16-0.51 in probes. Even if this holds it is unlikely to cover the pole.
